purpose: Priority-1 amplitude/target diagnosis on the existing K=2 checkpoints: alpha sweep of the second-round update
definition: P(alpha) = P1 + alpha*(P2-P1). P1/P2 are computed under the group's ORIGINAL second-round configuration and then fixed. The interpolated tensor is fed DIRECTLY to the TaskNet and does NOT pass through R2P again. Feedback-off is NOT alpha=0.
scope: frozen checkpoints; no training, no weight update; 24 fixed images; diagnostic/exploratory only

subset.selection: first PER_SCENE images per scene, loader order
subset.honesty_note: scene-stratified, NOT stratified simultaneously by scene and difficulty; the composition is recorded, not chosen

rng_discipline: before each comparison TaskNet call (T2 and every alpha), the CPU and all CUDA RNG states saved immediately before the FIRST TaskNet call of that image are restored, so all of them see the identical diffusion noise stream as T1
loss_components: official DfPTaskLoss = L1 + (1-SSIM_loss) + phase + perceptual; components computed from the criterion's own submodules; the target's VGG features are cached once per image, which is identical to the module's own extractor(target.detach()) call
